architecture: torchvision ResNet-18, standard 7x7 stride-2 stem with maxpool, 512 features, no pretraining
optimizer: SGD lr=0.1 momentum=0.9 weight_decay=0.0001; clip=1.0; AMP
schedule: cosine per successful optimizer update, reset each task
classification: task-aware training and evaluation, expandable biased linear head, all rows trainable
class_order: sorted training class IDs, numpy.default_rng(seed).permutation; bind and hash on Kaggle before jobs
augmentation: 64x64 random crop padding 8; horizontal flip p=0.5; fixed ImageNet mean/std; deterministic validation without resize
diagnostic_reference: all task-1 validation images, same post-task-1 validation centroids for every method
primary_outcome: post-task-1 accuracy minus current task-1 accuracy
nc4_direction: agreement; negative association with forgetting is directionally expected
lag_pairing: exact epochs within current task; no interpolation or cross-boundary pairs

bootstrap.strategy: paired moving blocks stratified by task; never cross task boundaries; refit controls each replicate

seed_aggregation: method/config/dataset specific arithmetic mean and sample std of seed estimates; report all 3 seeds and unavailable entries
checkpoint: every epoch, two rolling full states; full latest transition states; task-end and final model snapshots
stop_rule: 100 epochs per task, no outcome-based early stop; cooperative session stop at epoch boundary
no_tuning_statement: No hyperparameter will be changed in response to the observed Tiny ImageNet scientific results. Engineering corrections that do not use hypothesis outcomes must be documented separately.
